functions.divergence: Canonical GC/1.3 emits a 0x50-byte frame and helper-based saved-register sequence instead of retail's 0x80-byte frame and stmw/lmw r20-r31 sequence; loop register allocation, branch scheduling and relocation count remain different.

functions.technique: The volatile one-word aggregate named retained is a narrowly scoped codegen-forcing artifact used to retain retail's otherwise dead stack copy and 0x10-byte frame. It is unlikely to reflect the original source and must not be propagated as a general reconstruction idiom.
